# Levelset

> Checks how ready a website is for AI agents and returns a score out of 100 with a fix for every finding.

## Use it

- [Check a site](/): the web page; paste an address and read the result
- [About](/about): what is checked, how pages are fetched and the limits

## For agents

- [MCP server card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): the check_site tool, over Streamable HTTP at /mcp
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): the pages of this site
